001package dev.nandi0813.api.Event;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Match;
004import lombok.Getter;
005import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
006import org.bukkit.event.Event;
007import org.bukkit.event.HandlerList;
008
009/**
010 * Fired on the main thread after a player's elo on a ladder changed. Not cancellable.
011 */
012@Getter
013public class EloChangeEvent extends Event {
014
015    private static final HandlerList handlers = new HandlerList();
016
017    /** The player, never null. */
018    private final Player player;
019    /** The ladder name, never null. */
020    private final String ladderName;
021    /** The elo before the change. */
022    private final int oldElo;
023    /** The elo after the change. */
024    private final int newElo;
025    /** The ranked match that caused the change, or null for admin changes. */
026    private final Match match;
027
028    /**
029     * Create a new elo change event.
030     * @param player The player
031     * @param ladderName The ladder name
032     * @param oldElo The elo before the change
033     * @param newElo The elo after the change
034     * @param match The match that caused the change, or null for admin changes
035     */
036    public EloChangeEvent(Player player, String ladderName, int oldElo, int newElo, Match match) {
037        this.player = player;
038        this.ladderName = ladderName;
039        this.oldElo = oldElo;
040        this.newElo = newElo;
041        this.match = match;
042    }
043
044    /**
045     * Get the elo change.
046     * @return {@code newElo - oldElo}; negative on a loss
047     */
048    public int getDelta() {
049        return newElo - oldElo;
050    }
051
052    @Override
053    public HandlerList getHandlers() {
054        return handlers;
055    }
056
057    /**
058     * Get the handler list of this event.
059     * @return The handler list
060     */
061    public static HandlerList getHandlerList() {
062        return handlers;
063    }
064
065}
